note: These are opt-in presets. Installation never schedules them automatically.

jobs.name: Daily job discovery
jobs.prompt: Check only explicitly configured public job sources, add new jobs, and produce a review queue. Never take an external action.

jobs.name: Deadline and follow-up review
jobs.prompt: Review local deadlines and next actions. Draft reminders locally. Do not send them.

jobs.name: Weekly outcome review
jobs.prompt: Summarize application outcomes and propose one versioned ranking-rubric improvement for replay evaluation.
